name: Ortho
description: No perspective at all - the same square everywhere, and only the weight of the line changing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; border-style: solid; border-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-width: calc(@calc(1 + 7 * @y / @Y) * 1px * 6 / @size-col); box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
